# SENZ Strategic Communications

> SENZ Strategic Communications (SENZ) is a founder-led strategic communications and digital solutions firm in the Philippines. It helps brands, leaders, and organizations strengthen positioning, visibility, reputation, websites, conversion paths, and digital systems. SENZ is part of FMB&CO.

Official website: https://www.senzpr.com/
About and founder: https://www.senzpr.com/about.html
Services: https://www.senzpr.com/services.html
Contact: https://www.senzpr.com/contact.html
Email: info.senz.pr@gmail.com

## Founder
Francine Marie Bautista (FMB), also known as Francine Bautista.
Title: Strategic Communications Consultant | Founder, SENZ Strategic Communications & FMB&CO
Francine Marie Bautista (FMB) is a Filipina strategic communications consultant from Masinloc, Zambales, Philippines, and founder of SENZ Strategic Communications and FMB&CO, advising brands, leaders, and organizations on positioning, public relations, reputation, and public perception.
Canonical profile: https://francinemariebautista.com/profile/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/francine-marie-bautista-23437a3b5
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Binibiningfmb

## Organization
Parent organization: FMB&CO (founded by Francine Marie Bautista)
Area served: Philippines
